grammar.summary: 本课记述作者夫妇游览巴尔干半岛偏僻村庄的经历，大量运用分词短语作状语和独立主格结构描述场景，用定语从句修饰地点与人物，并通过过去完成时交代先于主线的动作。

points.title: 独立主格结构 (Absolute Construction)
points.explanation: 独立主格由「名词/代词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语」构成，独立于主句之外补充说明背景或伴随状态。本课用 the only sign of life being an ugly-looking black goat... 描述村庄寂静中的唯一生命迹象，渲染荒凉氛围。

examples.en: The village seemed deserted, the only sign of life being an ugly-looking black goat on a short length of rope tied to a tree in a field nearby.
examples.cn: 村里似乎无人居住，唯一的生命迹象是附近田里一只面目可憎的黑山羊，用一截短绳拴在一棵树上。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrases)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语置于句首或句中作状语，表示伴随动作或方式。本课用 Taking a path...、Sitting down...、Looking up... 等分词短语叙述作者夫妇的一系列动作，使叙事连贯流畅。

examples.en: Taking a path which led out of the town, we crossed a few fields until we came to a dense wood.
examples.cn: 我们走上了一条出镇的小路，穿过几块农田，来到一片茂密的树林。

examples.en: Sitting down on a dilapidated wooden fence near the field, we opened a couple of tins of sardines and had a picnic lunch.
examples.cn: 我们在田边一堵东倒西歪的篱笆墙上坐下来，打开几听沙丁鱼罐头，吃了一顿野外午餐。

examples.en: Looking up I saw that we were surrounded by children in rags who were looking at us silently as we ate.
examples.cn: 我抬头一看，发现我们被一群衣衫褴褛的小孩团团围住了，他们在默不作声地看着我们吃饭。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词表示「先于过去某一时间点」已完成的动作。本课用 We had spent several days... 交代「在离开前一天」之前已经度过的数日，为后文「决定去乡间」提供时间背景。

examples.en: We had spent several days in a small town and visited a number of old churches in the vicinity.
examples.cn: 我们在一座小镇上逗留了几天，参观了附近的许多古老的教堂。

exercises.q: The village seemed deserted, the only sign of life ______ an ugly-looking black goat on a short length of rope tied to a tree in a field nearby.
______ a path which led out of the town, we crossed a few fields until we came to a dense wood.
We ______ spent several days in a small town and visited a number of old churches in the vicinity.
用分词填空：______ up I saw that we were surrounded by children in rags who were looking at us silently as we ate.（写出 look 的现在分词形式，作伴随状语）
